page.overview:
Who is Master van Schagen?

Master van Schagen was a Redanian man and the father of Celia.

In , Master van Schagen met Geralt of Rivia at the Seven Cats Inn, where he asked the witcher to investigate who was seeing his daughter every night, as this mysterious man snuck past all of his daughter's guards and climbed the tower she was in. A fight broke out, and Geralt left to go investigate.
